notes:
A medical and news term for the surgical transfer of organs from one person to another. Composed of ⟦{臓器|ぞうき}→臓器：05705_zouki⟧ (organ) + ⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧ (transplant). Japan has historically had low rates of organ transplantation compared to Western countries, partly due to cultural attitudes toward brain death and bodily integrity.

- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ — organ transplant surgery
- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}{法|ほう} — Organ Transplant Law
